text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While cleaning up after training, 
something glinted at my feet. It was a 
well-worn, worn-down horseshoe...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's Boo's treasure! You found it 
for me? Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Every single horseshoe I've ever 
worn, I've kept safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Horseshoes were made by humans to protect 
our legs, right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So it's both a gift and a treasure! Even 
after it's used up, even after it breaks, 
I wanna cherish it forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, hey, wanna see? My super-precious 
collection!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
These are all the special touches from the 
farriers, y'know?! Every single one holds 
memories, right?! There's so much to see 
hereee!
choice_data_list: I want to see it right now!
Wait, let's put away the valuables first.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: All right! Just wait for meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, take a good look! This 
right here is my greatest treasure--!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's start with my very first 
horseshoes! The day I bought horseshoe 
running shoes, I was so happy I slept 
hugging them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blast Onepiece begins recounting her story 
with great affection. I took the time to 
listen carefully to her precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really okay with that? Not 
watching...?
choice_data_list: I can tell just how much you cherish it.
I can tell just how much you cherish it.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... Does that mean it was totally 
obvious? That makes me feel kinda 
ticklish!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Well, long as the thought gets across, 
that's what counts! Like, huge thanks to 
the farrier, as always!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Since you take such good care of me, I'll 
do my best to return the favor!
